method: Read-only factory pkgdef decoding and BAML/CIL inspection with ILSpy 9.1.0.7988; no Visual Studio setting changes.
limitations: Colors are #AARRGGBB, including alpha; slot null means no override, not transparent.
Only binary_type=1 is converted to ARGB; other binary payloads remain unresolved.
Main-window legacy resource aliases and DWM/material backdrop must be distinguished from ShellInternal tokens.
Typography fields are initial defaults and can be replaced by Visual Studio environment settings.
Base Light Text Editor Plain Text is absent from EditorColors.pkgdef; its inherited background is not proven by this file.
Rendered pixels, external window corners, active preferences and DPI were not measured.

geometry_data.source: Factory BAML/CIL; filled vector paths, not font characters.
